##### Project general facts

Terrazzo Residences is a sublime residential development, right across from the community's largest park. Pairing modern architecture with panoramic views and a natural earthly color aesthetic, this project offers the perfect balance of luxury, convenience, and serenity. Featuring a collection of one to three-bedroom apartments tailor-made for a harmonious family living experience, Terrazzo is where the zenith of luxury and serenity meet.

Residents enjoy a wealth of world-class amenities designed to elevate everyday living. Unwind in an infinity pool overlooking the lush Community Park, stay active in indoor and outdoor gyms, and enjoy indoor and outdoor entertainment zones. A dedicated kids' playground ensures family-friendly living, while the double-height indoor gym adds a touch of grandeur to fitness routines. Every element is crafted to create a lifestyle where luxury amenities meet natural beauty.

Every residence at Terrazzo features carefully crafted interiors that exude warm elegance and timeless sophistication. The thoughtfully designed spaces reflect a commitment to quality and comfort, with modern finishes and natural earthly tones that create a serene and inviting atmosphere. Each apartment is a sanctuary of style and tranquility, offering a harmonious living experience that embraces the perfect balance of nature and modern design.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, this exceptional location offers residents a wealth of man-made parks and green spaces, with more than forty well-kept areas making JVC the place to be for those looking to get back to nature. The community is well connected to major roads such as Al Khail Road and Hessa Street, ensuring easy travel around Dubai for business or pleasure.

The location is distinguished by its abundance of amenities, including Circle Mall with its retail stores, an exhaustive list of restaurants, bars, and cafes, and easy access to Dubai's top beaches including JBR, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. Right across from JVC's biggest community park, residents enjoy panoramic views of lush greenery and absolute serenity, with JSS International School, Ladybird Nursery, and Right Health facilities nearby.

For those seeking a residence that embodies harmony, luxury, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of green spaces, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can embrace the perfect balance.
